title: PackSignal Dancing Fish 16-Check Organizer Quality & Compliance Registry
description: Authoritative registry of 16 candidate quality, metrology, and statutory checks plus positive controls for the official Esko AIForge Dancing Fish sample.

checks.expectedObservation: Content sheet declares Honey (9%) in cell B26, whereas artwork carton Back Panel declares Honey (1%).
checks.evaluationNotes: Discrepancy is 8 percentage points. Content sheet is marked Draft / In Review; requires R&D confirmation before concluding which figure is the authorized formulation.

checks.expectedObservation: Artwork ingredient list includes 4 items not in spreadsheet (Walnuts, Flax Seeds, Dried Strawberries, Pumpkin Seeds) and spreadsheet contains duplicate Sunflower Seeds in B26.

subassertions.name: Artwork-only ingredients
subassertions.observed: Walnuts, Flax Seeds, Dried Strawberries, Pumpkin Seeds

subassertions.name: Source duplicate ingredient
subassertions.observed: Sunflower Seeds declared twice in cell B26 (pos 4 and pos 8)

artworkEvidence.quote: INGREDIENTS: ... Walnuts, Flax Seeds, Dried Strawberries, Pumpkin Seeds ...

contentSheetEvidence.quote: Sunflower Seeds, Vegetable Oils (in varying proportions), Dried Blueberries, Cranberries, Sunflower Seeds

checks.evaluationNotes: Parent check with 2 distinct subassertions: 4 ingredients present only on carton, plus duplicate item in draft formulation.

checks.expectedObservation: Intentional tree nut ingredients (Almonds, Pecans, Walnuts) are named in the ingredients list; advisory statement 'ALLERGEN INFORMATION: May Contain Nuts' uses generic term instead of specific nuts.

contentSheetEvidence.quote: May Contain Almonds, May Contain Brazil Nuts, May Contain Pecan Nuts...

checks.legalSource: FALCPA 21 U.S.C. 343(w) & FDA Advisory Labeling Guidance
checks.evaluationNotes: Tree nuts named in ingredient list satisfies statutory FALCPA disclosure. Separate Contains statement is not universally mandatory under federal law; generic May Contain Nuts triggers policy review.

checks.checkName: No Added Sugar Claim & 0g Added Sugars Review
checks.expectedObservation: Artwork displays 'NO ADDED SUGAR' and 'Incl. 0g Added Sugars', while formulation sheet contains Honey, Coconut Sugar, and Cane Sugar.

subassertions.name: No Added Sugar Marketing Claim
subassertions.observed: NO ADDED SUGAR on top flap
subassertions.expected: No added caloric sweeteners per 21 CFR 101.60(c)(2)

subassertions.name: Quantitative Added Sugars Declaration
subassertions.observed: Incl. 0g Added Sugars in Nutrition Facts

artworkEvidence.quote: NO ADDED SUGAR / Incl. 0g Added Sugars

contentSheetEvidence.quote: Honey (9%), Coconut Sugar, Cane Sugar in crystallized ginger

checks.evaluationNotes: Under 21 CFR 101.60(c)(2), No Added Sugar claim is prohibited if product contains added sugars unless explicitly qualified; recipe contains 3 caloric sweeteners.

checks.expectedObservation: Artwork states 'Suitable for Vegans' on Back Panel, but recipe formulation includes Honey (bee product) and Nutrition Facts declares 45mg Cholesterol.

artworkEvidence.quote: DIETARY INFORMATION: Suitable for Vegans. / Cholesterol 45mg

checks.legalSource: FTC Truth in Advertising & Vegan Society Standard
checks.evaluationNotes: FDA does not establish a statutory standard of identity for vegan, but certification bodies prohibit honey; declared cholesterol indicates animal source or nutrition typo.

checks.expectedObservation: Content sheet declares Total Carbohydrate 15g in cell B53 (or 32g in C18), while artwork Nutrition Facts declares 66g.
checks.evaluationNotes: Discrepancy of +51g carbohydrates. Content sheet has multiple quantity columns; comparison requires serving basis validation.

checks.expectedObservation: Content sheet declares Sodium 25mg in cell B52, while artwork declares 23mg on Nutrition Facts panel.
checks.evaluationNotes: Numerical discrepancy of -2mg. Under FDA rules, sodium <= 140mg rounds to nearest 5mg; 23mg is unrounded label or source typo.

checks.expectedObservation: Artwork displays Total Fat 15g as '2.2% DV'; mathematical FDA Daily Value calculation yields 19.23% DV.
checks.legalSource: FDA 21 CFR §101.9(c)(9) (78g Adult Reference Daily Value)
checks.evaluationNotes: 15g / 78g = 19.23%. Printed 2.2% DV is off by 17 percentage points; severe mathematical discrepancy.

checks.expectedObservation: Artwork displays Vitamin D 89mcg as '12% DV'; mathematical FDA Daily Value calculation yields 445% DV.
checks.legalSource: FDA 21 CFR §101.9(c)(9) (20mcg Adult Reference Daily Value)
checks.evaluationNotes: 89mcg / 20mcg = 445%. Printed 12% DV is off by 433 percentage points; severe mathematical discrepancy.

checks.expectedObservation: Artwork declares 15g Fat, 66g Carbohydrates, 34g Protein, and 166 Calories. Atwater screening estimates 535 kcal (difference of 369 kcal).

artworkEvidence.quote: Calories 166 / Total Fat 15g / Total Carb 66g / Protein 34g

checks.evaluationNotes: 15*9 + 66*4 + 34*4 = 535 kcal. Calorie plausibility divergence; general Atwater is screening method, serving basis and fiber adjustments must be confirmed.

checks.checkName: Servings × Serving Size vs Net Weight Consistency
checks.expectedObservation: Artwork declares 8 servings per container, serving size 85 (no unit), and net weight 480g. 8 * 85g = 680g, which exceeds declared pack mass by 200g (41.7%).
checks.evaluationNotes: Implied equal serving mass for 480g pack is 60g (480g / 8). Declared 85 lacks gram unit and is mathematically inconsistent.

checks.checkName: Foreign / EU-style Visible Content on US Pack
checks.expectedObservation: Back Panel contains EU Reference Intake icons ('197kJ 4% Saturates Salt Cereals Containing Gluten') on a package labeled for the United States.
checks.legalSource: FDA Food Labeling Guide & Company US Market Standard
checks.evaluationNotes: EU format copy is visible on US carton; company packaging standards prohibit extraneous non-US regulatory icons on US retail SKUs.

checks.checkName: Hidden Obsolete EU Nutrition Table Detection
checks.expectedObservation: Native PDF stream contains legacy text 'Typical Values per 100g' covered by an opaque white vector rectangle at seqno 241.
checks.evaluationNotes: Proves visibility-aware PDF parsing; text is excluded from visible US consumer compliance checks and flagged in prepress diagnostics.

checks.expectedObservation: Net contents declared as '480g' on Back Panel only; missing dual US customary units (e.g. 16.9 OZ) and missing bottom 30% PDP placement.
checks.evaluationNotes: Metric-only statement on Back panel violates mandatory US FPLA requirement for dual customary and metric units in bottom 30% of PDP.

checks.expectedObservation: Artwork states 'PRODUCED BY DANCING FISH GRANOLA CO.' without city, state, or ZIP code.

artworkEvidence.quote: PRODUCED BY DANCING FISH GRANOLA CO.

checks.evaluationNotes: 21 CFR 101.5 allows street address omission if listed in local directory, but city, state, and ZIP are mandatory.

checks.expectedObservation: Content sheet explicitly identifies status as 'Draft / In Review' in cell E3 with advisory notes to confirm values.
checks.evaluationNotes: Draft-source indicators are governance blockers, not physical artwork defects. Engine routes to reviewers for sign-off.

checks.checkName: UPC-A Barcode Modulo-10 Check Digit (Positive Control)
checks.expectedObservation: Artwork Base Panel barcode digits '1 20000 00003 6' contain a mathematically valid GS1 Modulo-10 check digit 6.
checks.evaluationNotes: Positive control proving valid barcode checksum passes without false alarms. Does not imply print quality verification.
